description: The user's own LinkedIn follower count over time, from readings we record about twice a day. Use it for every follower question: 'how many followers do I have?', 'how many did I gain this week?', 'how has my follower count changed since June?'. Returns the latest count, the count at the start of the window, the change, and a series with one point per day (per week for windows over 90 days). linkedin_analytics has no follower metric, so never say follower growth is unavailable without calling this first.

days.description: How many days back to look (default 30, max 730).

name: linkedin_follower_history
title: Get LinkedIn follower history
